summary: Add an accessible inline editor for every task, reuse existing task metadata options, update state atomically on save, and cover editing behavior with automated and browser tests.
steps: Add edit-session state and save/cancel handlers that validate and atomically update an existing task.
Render labelled inline editing controls and an edit action without disrupting existing task actions.
Style the edit form consistently with the current responsive task list.
Add automated coverage for saving, validation, cancellation, completion-state preservation, and localStorage persistence.
Update directly related feature documentation and run all configured evaluation checks.
risks: A saved task may immediately leave the current filtered or searched view when edited metadata no longer matches.
Editing a completed task must not reset its completion state.
Hidden row actions must remain keyboard discoverable.
